Packaging fixes for 0.1.0. The library itself is unchanged: same API, same
ABI.

### Packages

Built with CPack from the project's install rules, each named after the
version:

| File | What it holds |
| :--- | :--- |
| `rtxui-0.1.1-linux-x64.tar.gz` | Debug and Release static libraries, headers, CMake package, pkg-config file |
| `rtxui-0.1.1-macos-universal.tar.gz` | The same, for arm64 and x86_64 |
| `rtxui-0.1.1-windows-x64.zip` | The same, built with MSVC (`/MD` runtime; `rtxuid.lib` for Debug) |
| `librtxui-dev_0.1.1_amd64.deb` | Release library for Debian and Ubuntu |
| `rtxui-devel-0.1.1-1.x86_64.rpm` | Release library for Fedora and other RPM distributions |
| `rtxui-0.1.1.tar.gz` | The source, as committed |

Before publishing, the release installs the .deb on Ubuntu 24.04 and the .rpm
on Fedora, and builds an app against each with `find_package(rtxui)` and with
pkg-config.

### Fixes

- Every package now carries the MIT `LICENSE` (in `share/doc/rtxui/`), and so
  does `cmake --install`.
- `rtxui.pc` finds its prefix from its own location: 0.1.0's named the build
  machine's `/usr/local`, so pkg-config pointed elsewhere once the archive was
  unpacked.
- There is now a Windows package.

A prebuilt static C++ library links with a compatible compiler and standard
library: GCC or Clang with libstdc++ on Linux, Apple Clang on macOS, MSVC on
Windows. Otherwise, build from source with FetchContent, as described in
[Getting started](https://arthursonzogni.github.io/RTXUI/guide/getting-started).
